messages:
jun: Heads-up — nightly eval at 03:00 showed a sharp tail spike on the open-domain prompt set after last night's kernel merge. Lots of short repeats ("the the the" style) and increased perplexity on span-fill tasks.

samir: saw a few examples in the alert. Is this correlated with the fused-attn reorder patch?

jun: looks like it. Canary used the new interleaved attention path + stochastic scheduling change. Repro locally on quantized q4f16 with the exact nightly build.

olivia: can you paste a failing sample?

jun: sure — here's one from eval-bot output (trimmed):

```
input: "Write a short story about a gardener who finds a secret door."
gold: "...the gardener opened the door and found..."
model: "The the the gardener walked walked walked into into into the the door..."
```

miriam: ugh. That looks like a sampling/rng churn issue (stochastic state leaking). Did we change RNG init or seed handling in the kernel?

kai: patch notes show we moved RNG state allocation to per-thread workspace to reduce memcpy. Might have introduced reuse across microbatches when microbatch size < threads.

samir: also noticed the KV cache prefetch reorder changed ordering of kv writes — if sampler reads logits concurrently with a partial write it could see repeated high-prob tokens.

jun: i dumped logits for step 5-7. The top logits jump to the same token repeatedly across successive steps, probability mass ~0.6 each time before softmax normalization stabilizes. Attn scores are near-identical — looks like attention output sometimes duplicates a column.

olivia: does this only show up with quantized builds? or fp16 too?

jun: stronger in q4f16 nightly, but small repro in fp16 too. Nightly eval stats: q4f16 repeat-rate +12% vs baseline, fp16 +3%.

miriam: can we re-run with single-threaded scheduling and deterministically pinned rng to confirm race?

jun: ran single-threaded: no repeats. Ran with fixed rng per-request: no repeats. Ran with stress harness toggling microbatching: reproduces when microbatch < threads and fused path enabled.

kai: ok that points to a concurrency ordering bug. I'll add an extra memory barrier around RNG/kv writes in fused path and run a short canary.

samir: also enqueue an eval set with seeds to check for seed-sensitivity; add logging to show thread-id and workspace pointer on each forward so we can correlate duplicates to pointer aliasing.

kai: putting a canary now (build b2149990455). deploy-bot: canary started on pool-rx-4.

deploy-bot: canary successful on smoke tests.

olivia: run full nightly eval subset (narrow prompt bank) before merging revert or full rollout.

eval-bot: queued: eval-subset-24 (200 prompts). ETA ~14m.

(14 minutes later)

eval-bot: results ready — repeat-rate dropped to baseline on canary with barrier patch. q4f16: -11% vs failing nightly, fp16: -2%.

miriam: good. Kai — open PR with barrier + comment describing thread-local rng allocation and microbatch invariants. Add a unit test that simulates threads > microbatch to prevent regression.

kai: will do. Also plan to run a backtest across the last 3 weeks of nightly diffs to ensure no other subtle duplications.

jun: thanks team. leaving the failing nightly marked "root cause suspected: concurrency interleave in fused-attn RNG/kv writes" and will follow up with a short writeup for postmortem if the fix is validated by the extended run. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: flagged failing nightly 2149989999 -> linked to this thread.
